The Vietnam National Museum of History stands as a significant landmark in Hanoi, attracting numerous visitors interested in delving into the rich tapestry of Vietnamese history. Established by the government in 2011, this museum is dedicated to preserving and showcasing the historical journey of Vietnam from prehistoric times to the present day.

For those planning a visit to Hanoi, the Vietnam National Museum of History is ideally situated near several other popular attractions. Within walking distance, visitors can explore the nearby Women’s Museum, which complements the historical narratives with insights into the social and cultural roles of women in Vietnamese society.
